title: modelfiler

messages.description: vertices <float>: number of vertices copied to the tables

methods.description: tables for the vertex positions: one (x y z interleaved) or three
tables for the vertex colors: one (r g b a interleaved) or four
tables for the vertex normals: one (x y z interleaved) or three
tables for the texture coordinates: one (u v interleaved) or two
backends to try first when reading the model
forget the properties stored with setProps
list the properties the backend supports, on the right outlet
query the named properties; the values come out of the right outlet
use only the given backends, in that order
set a backend property: name and value
store properties (name value ...) to use from the next open on

body: [modelfiler] reads a model and copies its vertex data into arrays, for [gemvertexbuffer] for example.
